description: Interactive Photo Gallery is a custom visual for Power BI designed to display and organize images directly within your reports. It is the ideal tool for creating product catalogs, staff directories, or evidence galleries. It stands out by including an adaptive grid layout, a pagination system to handle multiple photos without cluttering the screen, and an expanded view to see each image in detail with a single click. Transform your visual data into a seamless experience without leaving your dashboard. It features tools for zooming, measuring, and sending the user directly to the image from the browser.
keywords: Image Gallery Pro for Power BI
